summary_en: This study tests the xDRIVE Functional Precision Medicine and Artificial Intelligence tumor profiling test in patients with relapsed or refractory cancers in Florida. The test is a diagnostic test, not a drug, and it uses tumor tissue plus a blood or buccal swab sample; results go to the physician, who may use them to guide the next treatment, and how often or how long is not stated. The study measures patient clinical benefit and health economic impacts, as a feasibility study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la prueba de perfil tumoral xDRIVE de Medicina de Precisión Funcional e Inteligencia Artificial en pacientes con cáncer recidivante o refractario en Florida. La prueba es un examen diagnóstico, no un medicamento, y utiliza una muestra de tejido tumoral más una muestra de sangre o de frotis bucal; los resultados se entregan al médico, quien puede usarlos para guiar el siguiente tratamiento, y la frecuencia o duración no está indicada. El estudio mide el beneficio clínico para el paciente y los impactos económicos en salud, como estudio de factibilidad.
who_for: Recurrent or refractory cancer; adults 18 or older, or children under 18 (ages 7–17 must sign assent).
Received at least one prior line of standard cancer therapy, with treatment and outcome information available.
Adults with sufficient health to undergo cancer therapy (performance status 0, 1, or 2).
Scheduled for or recently had a tumor biopsy, excision, or resection.
Willing to give a blood sample or buccal swab for normal-tissue comparison.
not_for: No malignant tissue available or accessible for testing.
Malignant tissue amount too small (under 0.3 g for resections, or biopsies without malignant tissue).
Insufficient malignant tissue in peripheral blood or bone marrow aspirate samples.
Insufficient health indicators to undergo therapeutic intervention.
